verdicts.reason: Both break the flavor groupings the same way: the three names are stacked in reverse order, and their descriptors sit in a separate block in a different order, so each name no longer sits with its descriptor. Both also split the cans into one large can and two orphaned small ones at the bottom. A at least keeps the logo at the top and gives a full-width, prominent CTA, though its type stack is cramped and the logo is tiny. B wraps the headline so 'light' sits alone on the last line, pushes the logo to a near-invisible spot at the bottom edge, and squeezes a tiny CTA next to the ONLINE ONLY badge, which buries the action.
